stories.primary_headline: Hits & Misses: Liverpool clicking and Chelsea get serious

primary_source.headline: Hits & Misses: Liverpool clicking and Chelsea get serious
primary_source.content: Saturday 17 October 2026 21:37, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Liverpool spent close to £400m on Alexander Isak, Florian Wirtz and Bradley Barcola. Against Brentford, there was evidence that expensively-assembled attack might finally be clicking. Isak was on the fringes of the game for long periods, limited to only 16 touches by the dogged hosts. But his brilliantly-taken goal, controlled and rifled home with dizzying speed in the second half, was a reminder of just how deadly he can be at his best. It took him to five goals for the season. Only Erling Haaland has scored more in the Premier League. He is putting a difficult first season behind him and Andoni Iraola will be encouraged that it was Barcola who provided the assist. The France international came into the game off the back of scoring a hat-trick against LASK in midweek and while he couldn't find the net against Brentford, missing a golden opportunity in the first half and hitting the bar in the second, Iraola liked what he saw.

stories.primary_headline: Rahul Gandhi joins Congress' 'Goy Rakhon Yatra' in Goa; walks 2 km with party workers

primary_source.headline: Rahul Gandhi joins Congress' 'Goy Rakhon Yatra' in Goa; walks 2 km with party workers
primary_source.content: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi on Sunday participated in the party's 'Goy Rakhon Yatra' in Margao, walking two kilometres alongside party workers and leaders.Gandhi arrived at Dabolim airport in the afternoon to join the mass outreach programme. He is scheduled to address a public gathering at the Margao Cricket Club (MCC) ground later in the day.Among those who accompanied him during the yatra were AICC Goa desk in-charge Manikrao Thakare, co-in-charge Dr Anjali Nimbalkar, Leader of Opposition Yuri Alemao and Goa Pradesh Congress Committee president Girish Chodankar.The 27-day 'Goy Rakhon Yatra', led by Alemao and Chodankar, began on September 22 and concluded on Sunday. The campaign covered all 40 Assembly constituencies in Goa as the Congress seeks to strengthen its grassroots network ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections.Rahul Gandhi to address Goa rally as Congress wraps up 28-day 'Goy Rakhon Yatra'The party described the 'Goy Rakhon Yatra', which translates to a campaign to protect Goa, as a movement to safeguard the state's land, environment, cultural heritage and identity.Throughout the campaign, the Congress highlighted concerns over land conversion, alleged land grabbing, unemployment, corruption and public safety, while emphasising the need to preserve Goa's distinct social and cultural identity.The yatra also aimed to engage with local communities and bring development-related issues to the forefront of political discussions.With the 2027 Goa Assembly elections approaching, the Congress is seeking to expand its grassroots presence and mobilise support across constituencies, including those currently represented by the ruling BJP.
